description: Phase 4 MerLin ADAPTATION of E4 (not the original): two-branch photonic virtual classifier, 2 photons in 4 modes, (x1, x2) phase-encoded on modes 0-1, PNR (FOCK) detection, partial distinguishability noise (indistinguishability 0.9). Same data, split, loss, accuracy rule and optimizer as e4_vqc_original. Sweep --vqc-merlin-budget and --seed/--seed-data.
